notes.general_comments:
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were Questions 1, 2, 5, 8, 12, 13, 20,
21, 23, 28, 29 and 30. They covered a range of topics from different parts of the syllabus and were set to test
different skills.
The questions that candidates found most challenging were Questions 6, 14, 17 and 27. The rest of the
questions gave results which were well within the levels expected.
